statement: The orientation of the 1532 Honterus Chorographia resists verification and is marked uncertain rather than asserted.
resolution_path: Consult the surviving impression once located.

statement: The single known print is recorded as 'likely Budapest'; the holding institution is not confirmed.
resolution_path: Confirm the repository and shelfmark before any survival_unknown attestation is resolved.

statement: Drobeta cannot securely be matched to an entry in Ptolemy's catalogue of forty-four poleis.
resolution_path: Record as source_silent at low confidence unless an edition settles the identification.

statement: The exact site of Vicina is unsettled in the literature.
resolution_path: Carry as scholarly_reconstruction with competing candidates rather than one point.

statement: The KAN-349 timeline is normalized but no witness scope or absence state has been reviewed by a named researcher.
resolution_path: Select bounded samples, review source scope and locators, then promote individual states; do not bulk-promote the timeline.

statement: The KAN-354 source and claim ledgers are candidate research records, not reviewed interpretations of territorial advocacy.
resolution_path: Review each high-importance claim against the cited map, legend, text, or diplomatic record and name the reviewer.

statement: No high-resolution Borroczyn or later comparison witness currently combines adequate parcel detail with a production-wide reuse grant.
resolution_path: Obtain a production-resolution reproduction and written reuse terms from the holding institution, or document a rights-cleared equivalent witness.

statement: No line in the Roman Dacia baseline is digitised from a survey or an open licensed dataset. Roads are straight joins between attested stations and the three frontier corridors are drawn by this project at provincial scale.
resolution_path: Replace the drawn corridors with digitised geometry from a licensed source, or cite a reusable dataset, and raise the provenance class from editorial_reconstruction accordingly.

statement: The principality rings are schematic envelopes, not delimitations. Two known simplifications are recorded: the Budjak and Cetatea Alba are not separated from Moldavia before 1775, and the southern Bessarabian districts returned in 1856 are not drawn as their own phase.
resolution_path: Cut the two missing phases and reconcile the rings against a delimitation source before any layer here is cited as a boundary.

statement: Every sheet in the Josephinian index carries archive_sheet_id 'pending': the footprints are a reconstructed graticule and no row has been matched to the Kriegsarchiv's own sheet number.
resolution_path: Match each footprint to its Kriegsarchiv sheet number and replace the reconstructed graticule with the archive's index geometry.

statement: No name-use record has passed human review. Seven of twelve are normalized, which is as far as machine-assisted work may go: the promotion ladder refuses llm_assisted above normalized without a named reviewer, and a reviewed row also needs a real locator.
resolution_path: A named reviewer checks each row against its cited source and records reviewer and review_date. KAN-345, KAN-346 and KAN-347 all require reviewed records and cannot start until at least one example of each fate class has been cleared.

statement: Five uses are exercised by an institution rather than carried by a witness - the Dominican province, the two marque phases, the reception use and the 1974 restoration - and none has a locator. They stay raw because `pending` is not a value a normalized row may carry.
resolution_path: Cite the instrument that exercised the name in each case: the decree for the 1974 restoration, the corporate or trademark record for the marque, and a bibliographic anchor for the Dominican province.

statement: None of the six candidate visual witnesses is cleared for publication. Two need permission from the holding institution, three need a rights review, and no reproduction has been resolved for any of them.
resolution_path: Settle a rights basis and a usable reproduction for at least one witness, or write the essay from description and record that decision at the rights gate.
